name: revolved-fillet-shoulder
why: A radiused shoulder in a revolve section, held to Pappus: 2000 pi - 2 pi (10 - d) s with s = 9 - 9pi/4 and d = 3(5/6 - pi/4)/(1 - pi/4), 6169.963 mm3 (derivation in the script). The rounded corner revolves into an exact torus face; the exact B-rep reads 6169.962838 (STEP probe), equal to the closed form at every printed digit.
